title: Missense3D: leveraging protein structures, including AlphaFold models, to understand the effect of missense variants.
authors: Tsitsa, Ifigenia; Hanna, Gordon; Conev, Anja; Islam, Suhail A; Sternberg, Michael Je; David, Alessia
one_liner_zh: 该文介绍Missense3D工具，利用实验和AlphaFold预测的蛋白质结构分析错义突变的结构后果，属于蛋白质结构计算应用，但偏工程化工具而非方法创新。
abstract: The growing availability of 3D protein structures enables large-scale assessment of missense variants and their phenotypic impact. Missense3D, first developed in 2019, predicts the structural consequences of amino acid substitutions and provides mechanistic explanations by identifying features such as cavities, steric clashes and disrupted non-covalent bonds that may cause protein misfolding. The new Missense3D algorithm presented here accepts genomics, protein, and structural coordinates; models variants on both single proteins and protein-protein complexes using experimental and predicted structures, including AlphaFold models; performs automated sequence-structure mapping; and evaluates structural model quality before analysis. The Missense3D web server is freely available to all users, including commercial ones, at https://missense3d.bc.ic.ac.uk/~missense3d2/.
abstract_zh: 3D蛋白质结构的日益普及使得大规模评估错义变异及其表型影响成为可能。Missense3D最初于2019年开发，预测氨基酸替换的结构后果，并通过识别可能导致蛋白质错误折叠的特征（如空腔、空间冲突和破坏的非共价键）提供机制性解释。此处介绍的新版Missense3D算法接受基因组学、蛋白质和结构坐标；使用实验和预测结构（包括AlphaFold模型）在单一蛋白质和蛋白质-蛋白质复合物上建模变异；执行自动序列-结构映射；并在分析前评估结构模型质量。Missense3D网络服务器对所有用户（包括商业用户）免费开放，网址为https://missense3d.bc.ic.ac.uk/~missense3d2/。
